title: Wall (walls/items/<id>/wall.json)
description: What a low wall or a retaining wall is faced with, as the house view draws it along the line given for it: render, stone, brick, concrete. Its texture is painted from a few numbers, like the surface of a path, and seen on the upright faces of the wall.

draft.description: Colour of the wall on the overlay of the editor, where it is drawn flat and bright rather than lit.

surface.description: What the faces are made of. A row of its units is a course: the height of a stone or of a brick comes first in `cell`, then its length along the wall.

coping.description: Capping laid on top of the wall, a little wider than it: a row of flat stones, a concrete cap, a tile course. Without it the top has the colour of the faces.

height.description: Height of the capping, in metres.

overhang.description: How far it juts out on each side of the wall, in metres.
